column3: Setup: Use the update_request_rejection testdrive - it supplies journal_4 ('Update Request Rejection - Reject Reject Unreject <run_seed>'), an in-DOAJ journal with two Update Requests already Rejected in its history: an older one (titled '...OLDER rejected UR, accept this one <run_seed>', APC $100) and a newer one (titled '...newer rejected UR, ignore this one <run_seed>', APC $250). Pre-building both, already rejected, avoids two live submissions to the same journal in quick succession, which risks tripping DOAJ's real update-request submission cooldown - this test is about proving the older rejected request can still be accepted (and its data wins) even though a newer, also-rejected one exists. OR provide those yourself.

Setup: Important: the testdrive page tears down its data as soon as you navigate away from it. Log in and run the test in a separate browser tab/window, leaving the testdrive tab open until you have finished.
Locate the OLDER of the two Rejected Update Requests for journal_4 (titled '...OLDER rejected UR, accept this one') via the admin area search

column4: The Journal page shows an APC of $100 (from the OLDER Update Request), NOT $250 (from the newer, ignored, Rejected Update Request)

column3: Search for journal_4's ISSN in the admin journal search

column4: There is only one Journal published in DOAJ with that ISSN

column3: Find the accepted application via the admin search (e.g. filter by Accepted and sort by last updated most recent first)
